name: VyOS
what_it_is: VyOS is an open-source network operating system for routers and firewalls built as a Debian-based GNU/Linux distribution. It packages a Linux kernel, FRR (Free Range Routing), and Netfilter into a unified, configurable network OS supporting a wide range of routing and VPN protocols.
components: FRR (Free Range Routing) — handles BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RIP
Custom VyOS CLI and configuration system
measurement: No built-in metrics exporter confirmed in README
Interface statistics available via CLI show commands
configuration: Hierarchical CLI (similar to Junos-style set/commit/rollback model)
Configuration stored as a structured text file (config.boot)
Supports loading configuration at boot from config.boot
Build-time configuration via scripts/ and data/ directories
ISO build produces embedded Debian + VyOS packages
fault_injection: No fault injection tooling identified in the repository
modes: Operational mode — monitoring, show commands, ping, traceroute
Docker container mode — build environment for compiling VyOS packages and ISO
constraints: Requires Docker for the standard build workflow; bare-metal builds are not the recommended path
Build targets Debian-based systems; non-Debian host environments may require additional setup
Separate git repositories for VyOS packages are managed as submodules, requiring recursive clone
Active development branch is 'current'; LTS branches (sagitta/1.4, equuleus/1.3) are maintained separately and may differ in feature availability
docker_services: vyos-build container — Debian-based build environment used to compile packages and produce the VyOS ISO; no docker-compose.yml found at root or docker/ paths on the current branch
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found in the repository (404 at both root and docker/ paths on current branch)
No built-in network traffic generation or simulation tooling
No native metrics/telemetry exporter (e.g., Prometheus) confirmed in build repo
No fault injection or chaos engineering hooks identified
No GUI management interface — CLI only
